steps.what: Consider ensemble abilities, score availability, and musical variety to select performance music

tasks.design: Keep repertoire selection with the music director. Existing scores and availability information in {DOCS} support a decision that balances ensemble ability and the musical programme.
tasks.previous_blocker: A work's instrumentation or duration does not establish its suitability for this ensemble.
tasks.enabler_now: No automated repertoire decision is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Judging challenge, musical contrast, performer development, and audience experience.
tasks.human_edge: The director knows how the ensemble sounds and what it can achieve through rehearsal.

reach.task: Clarify score availability for candidate repertoire

evidence.claim: Ensemble-specific repertoire selection requires musical judgement; no labour saving is assumed.

assumptions: Boundary covers selecting repertoire, not obtaining scores, rehearsing, or performance scheduling.

Director supplies ensemble capability knowledge from existing work; music librarian or score supplier supplies existing availability information before selection. No new structured capability rating or catalogue feed is required.
Native document and catalogue access remain sufficient; unchanged practice adds zero incremental upkeep.
research_questions: Which repertoire decisions depend on direct knowledge of this ensemble rather than catalogue facts?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero because musical selection remains unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Determine the musical elements of a composition

steps.what: Determine voices, instruments, harmony, rhythm, tempo, and tone balance for the desired effect

tasks.design: Retain compositional choices in the music notation or composition application {OTHER}. Existing playback helps the composer listen, without converting an artistic decision into an automatic rule.
tasks.previous_blocker: The desired musical effect is an artistic judgement rather than a fixed acceptance test.
tasks.enabler_now: No justified automation of compositional decisions is established by the digest.
tasks.still_hard: Balancing expressive intent, playable writing, and relationships among musical elements.
tasks.human_edge: The composer hears whether the chosen structure expresses the intended idea.
tasks.altitude: Compositional authority and responsibility stay unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss how an instrumental balance affects the composition

evidence.claim: Notation transcription does not establish automated composition judgement; no saving is assumed for choosing musical elements.

assumptions: Boundary is choosing musical structure and orchestration, excluding exploratory sound trials and transcription into notation counted separately. OTHER is the composition and notation application.
Composer supplies musical intent and creates the choices during s1; no structured target-emotion field or generated acceptance flag is assumed.
Native composition and playback tools remain sufficient; existing runtime earns no labour saving and the unchanged workflow adds zero upkeep.
research_questions: Which compositional decisions require listening with the intended performers?

incremental.description: No additional system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; gross and net saving zero. Artistic choices remain human and current playback runtime is excluded.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Experiment with sounds and musical ideas

steps.what: Experiment with sounds and musical passages using synthesizers and computers to evaluate ideas

tasks.design: Retain sound exploration and critical listening in the synthesizer and music-production toolset {OTHER}. Existing presets and playback support experiments without removing the composer's listening and adjustment work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Unexpected musical results can be valuable, so exploration lacks a fixed success rule.
tasks.enabler_now: No additional automated exploration is proposed.
tasks.still_hard: Hearing which sound relationships deserve development and which are distractions.
tasks.human_edge: The composer recognises an expressive possibility that was not specified beforehand.
tasks.altitude: Creative exploration remains part of the composer's work.

reach.task: Discuss a timbre or sound-processing alternative

evidence.claim: Sound experimentation and evaluation remain artistic work; no labour saving is assumed from existing synthesis tools.

assumptions: Boundary is exploratory sound and passage trials, excluding final compositional decisions and later notation. OTHER is the existing synthesizer and music-production toolset.
Composer produces trial settings and listens to the resulting sound during s1. No new structured feed, preference prediction, or automated quality decision is introduced.
Native presets and playback remain the first choice; unchanged practice adds zero incremental upkeep. Passive playback runtime is not counted as removable labour.
research_questions: Which exploratory operations are mechanical repetition rather than musically useful listening?

incremental.description: No new system or process upkeep

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100; net saving zero. Listening, adjustment, and evaluation remain unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Transcribe composition ideas into musical notation

steps.what: Capture the musical idea and clarify the intended notes, rhythm, and phrasing
Transcribe the captured composition idea into editable musical notation

loop.purpose: Propose a notation transcription from the captured musical performance
loop.check: Composer listens against the source and checks pitch, rhythm, voices, rests, bar divisions, and intended phrasing
loop.stop: One transcription and one correction; ambiguous or dense passages are entered manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Audio does not uniquely specify symbolic pitch, rhythm, and voice separation; direct digital note entry should be tested first

steps.what: Correct and play through the notation to preserve the intended composition

tasks.design: Use audio-to-score drafting in the notation application {OTHER} only after the composer captures the intended idea. Keep correction and musical playback review with the composer; the draft does not change composition choices.
tasks.previous_blocker: Manually entering notes can repeat an idea already performed or recorded.
tasks.enabler_now: Audio-to-score tools produce editable notation that can be corrected rather than re-entered.
tasks.still_hard: Polyphonic ambiguity, expressive timing, enharmonic spelling, and clear notation for performers.
tasks.human_edge: The composer knows which heard details belong in the score and which are performance variation.
tasks.altitude: Less first-pass entry may leave more time for performer-readable notation.

reach.task: Check notation clarity before preparing parts

evidence.claim: ScoreCloud converts audio into an editable score with chords and MusicXML export; this supports transcription assistance, not guaranteed notation accuracy.
The time estimate for reviewed transcription is E1 and requires testing on the composer's actual music.

assumptions: Boundary is notation of an already conceived idea, excluding composing, exploratory sound work, and later public performance. OTHER is the recording and notation toolset.

Composer produces the source recording, selected passage, intended instrumentation, pitch reference, and approximate metre or tempo in s1; capture and clarifying time remain counted. Incomplete or ambiguous source returns to manual entry.
Test direct digital note capture and native notation entry before audio interpretation. No structured perfect note stream is presumed and no publication occurs automatically.
research_questions: Does transcription plus full correction take less active time than direct notation entry for representative passages?

already_counted.description: Correct and play through notation against the intended composition

incremental.description: Maintain capture settings and check recurring transcription mistakes

role.altitude: The musician retains repertoire and compositional judgement while checking editable transcriptions of already formed ideas.
role.ambitious_version: A musician who preserves creative decisions and makes chosen ideas easier to turn into usable scores.
